OneDrive: your app at Microsoft

Once, on a computer: entra.microsoft.com › App registrations › New registration. For account types, pick the one that includes personal Microsoft accounts. Then, under Authentication, turn on “Allow public client flows”. Copy the “Application (client) ID” and type it here (you can type from your phone, in the panel).
Application (client) ID
On your phone or computer, open microsoft.com/link (or point the camera at the QR) and type the code below. The TV only asks to read files.
Microsoft did not accept this app. Check the ID and that “Allow public client flows” is on.

Once, on a computer: dropbox.com/developers/apps › Create app › Scoped access › Full Dropbox. In the Permissions tab, tick files.metadata.read, files.content.read and account_info.read and save (Submit). Copy the “App key” and type it here.
App key
The App key has only lowercase letters and numbers.
Point your phone camera at the QR, sign in to Dropbox and tap Allow. Dropbox shows a code: type it here (you can type from your phone, in the panel).
Dropbox code
Type the whole code Dropbox showed.
